caption: Day 12 of 30 Family Dinners Toddlers Actually Eat 🤍 Cheesy Beef Tortilla Triangles 🌮🧀 Ingredients * 1 lb ground beef * 4 tortillas (cut in half) * 3 tbsp marinara sauce * 1½ cups mozzarella cheese * ½ cup cheddar cheese * 2 tbsp butter * ½ tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp onion powder * ½ tsp paprika * ½ tsp oregano * Salt (1 year+ only) * Black pepper Directions Cook the ground beef with the seasonings. Fill each tortilla half with marinara sauce, mozzarella, and beef, then fold into triangles. Mix melted butter with garlic powder and oregano, spread some in the baking dish, arrange the triangles, brush the tops with the remaining butter, sprinkle with mozzarella and cheddar, and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 10–15 minutes until golden and crispy ✨ Serve with rice or a fresh salad 🤍 If you want even more recipes like this, MunchMind has 200+ baby & toddler-approved recipes, plus weekly personalized meal plans already planned for you and grocery lists to make the whole week easier 🤍 Find it in my bio ✨ #familydinner #tortillarecipe #easytoddlerrecipes #toddlermeals #toddlerrecipes
